title: Rosalía’s Canceled Florida Shows Rescheduled for September: Updated Lux Tour Dates
summary: One of the Spanish star's New York dates has also been rescheduled.
contentText:
After Rosalía postponed the first three dates of the North American leg of her Lux World Tour — initially set for June 4 and 6 in Miami, and June 8 in Orlando — new dates have been announced.

The concert in Orlando has been rescheduled for Sept. 9 at the KIA Center, while her shows at Miami’s Kaseya Center will now take place on Sept. 14 and Sept. 16. “All purchased tickets for the original show dates will be honored for the new dates,” reads the official announcement shared on Kaseya Center’s official Instagram on Thursday (June 11). 

One of her two shows in New York City has also been rescheduled for June 18 at the Madison Square Garden. She will also have a show there on June 17. The North American trek now officially kicks off Thursday (June 11) at the TD Garden in Boston.

The Spanish singer-songwriter—whose Lux World Tour is visiting 17 countries in Europe, the U.K., North America and Latin America—postponed the kick off of her North American stint due to a family emergency. 

Live Nation confirmed the news on X on June 4, stating: “Due to a family emergency,  Rosalía has to postpone her upcoming shows in Miami and Orlando. She is sorry to disappoint her fans, but the circumstances have left her with no other choice. As the tour explores rescheduling, please hold onto your ticket. More information soon.”
